steps.note: The spec as it opens: the layout Arena solved for it, a card per entry down the panel, and the asset browser under the view.
Round the island a little. The camera turns about a point well behind the island, so a little goes a long way.
One search over Arena's assets and NVIDIA's SimReady props.
The tree narrows it to the props.
A prop dragged onto the plate: the surface it would stand on lights up, and letting go adds it, standing `on` the plate.
The spatial graph: a node per object, an edge per relation.
Hovering a node outlines its object in the view: the pear, standing on the plate.
A click on an edge opens the relation's card, and draws what it asks for over the layout.
Its side, from the menu: the bowl goes round behind the plate. Of the menu's entries and the same text elsewhere, the one nearest the pointer.
Its distance dragged out: the shape follows the drag, the solve the release.
